source_title: Open source maintainers underpaid, swamped by security, going gray (The Register, on Tidelift's 2024 survey)
claim_or_approach: In Tidelift's 2024 survey, donations were 25 percent of maintainer income, the largest single source listed
support_quote: maintainers still largely receive income from donations (25 percent, from programs like GitHub Sponsors)
paraphrase: Donations edge out company salaries (24 percent).
uncertainty: Vendor survey of about 400 self-selected maintainers; WebFetch returned the sentence in fragments.
